arg_convention: 0x6363560(unused, obj, item, ctx) = (rdi, rsi, rdx, rcx). rdi is never read; rsi contributes only [obj+0x13450] for the gate; rdx is the item; rcx is moved to rbx and drives every ctx field access.

corrections_to_earlier_packets.#219_confirmed: The slot-insert helper 0x63ac0d0 is never called from this FDE; the slot at ctx+0xc8 is passed to the remove helper 0x63acb40 with the same (slot, node) convention.
corrections_to_earlier_packets.#220_confirmed: Same ctx layout (+0xc0 head, +0xc8 slot, +0xd8 anchor, +0xb0/+0xb8 counters), same obj/global gate ([obj+0x13450] vs .bss 0x650969c, jb skips), same anchor self-link rule ([item+0x28]==item clears the anchor), same (unused, obj, item, ctx) tuple shape.
corrections_to_earlier_packets.#220_refined: The rotation here is NOT byte-identical to #220 block 1: same successor exchange (item and [item+0x28] swap +0x30 successors) but different backlink writes — [s+0x28] keeps p_next here versus p in #220, and [p+0x28] is set to s here versus untouched in #220.
corrections_to_earlier_packets.#221_confirmed: The three feeder collect sites pass (ctx, obj, item, shard-ctx) and the feeder appends the item to its output array immediately after each call (store at 0x63eabc2, count at -0x70(%rbp)); the final sweep at 0x63ea778 calls 0x63612b0 at 7 sites (0x63ea7f3, 0x63ea81d, 0x63ea847, 0x63ea885, 0x63ea8aa, 0x63ea8ce, 0x63ea8f2).

counters.+0xa8: never touched here (contrast #220, which bumps +0xa8 on head replacement)
counters.+0xb0: decremented on every exit path (all five paths reach a subq $0x1, 0xb0(%rbx))
counters.+0xb8: decremented only on the slot-remove path, paired with the 0x63acb40 call

ctx_fields.+0xb8: slot-membership counter, decremented on slot-remove only
ctx_fields.+0xc0: head node pointer (compared, cleared when the item is the head)
ctx_fields.+0xc8: slot (16-byte chain head + second word), passed to 0x63acb40
ctx_fields.+0xd8: anchor node pointer (compared, advanced, or cleared)

output_array_consumer.append_sites: feeder stores the item at (%r11, %r10, 8) with count at -0x70(%rbp) immediately after each collect call (first site: store at 0x63eabc2)
output_array_consumer.consumer: feeder final sweep at 0x63ea778 calls 0x63612b0 (ctx, table value, item) once per collected item, 7 sites

paths.anchor_advance: item == [ctx+0xd8] and [item+0x28] != item: [ctx+0xd8] = [item+0x28], then the rotation block, then +0xb0--, ret
paths.gate_skip: table entry +0x10 == 1 but gate fails: +0xb0-- only, ret (no rotation, no counter change beyond +0xb0)
paths.head_clear: item == [ctx+0xc0]: [ctx+0xc0] = 0, +0xb0--, ret (no +0xa8 bump, unlike #220 head replacement)
paths.rotation: table entry +0x10 == 1, gate passes, item != anchor: successor-exchange rotation, +0xb0--, ret

remove_helper.fde: 0x63acb40..0x63ad582 (cited by address only, not decoded here)
remove_helper.role_observed_from_head: walks the slot chain with the same (+0x20, +0x8) signum idiom as the slot-insert helper and zeroes +0x28 pairs (movups %xmm0 stores)

table.selector: entry +0x10 word == 1 takes the gate path, otherwise the slot-remove path
